card.name: Just before pregnancy words begin
card.fires_on: The first piece of a word that continues as 'pregnancy' or 'pregnant', such as a lone P in capitals, 'pre-', or 'p' split off from a web address. It fires right before the 'regnancy' or 'regnant' part.

modes.label: Capitalized P in warnings
modes.description: A lone capital P starts PREGNANT or PREGNANCY in all-caps warning text.
modes.example: MISOPROSTOL SHOULD NOT BE TAKEN BY<< P>>REGNANT WOMEN TO REDUCE

modes.label: Pre- before pregnancy
modes.description: The hyphenated 'pre' or '-p' that begins 'pre-pregnancy' in dosing or weight text.
modes.example: Reduce levothyroxine sodium dosage to pre<<-p>>regnancy levels immediately after delivery.

modes.label: p in registry web address
modes.description: The letter p that starts 'pregnancyregistry' in a website address.

card.writes: It predicts that the next piece completes a pregnancy word, and it lowers the pregnancy tokens themselves, which are not what comes next.
card.plain: It marks a word that is split just before 'regnant' or 'regnancy', so the pregnancy word is only half spelled.
